ploidyspec report: drRubCham1

Summary

Structure in this individual's assembly, read from the sections below; not inheritance and not origin. See docs/guide, Chapter 6.

Ploidy

2 haplotype copies of each of 28 chromosome numbers; the numbers form sets of 4 (7 groups of mostly 4 chromosome numbers), so x ≈ 7 and up to 8x relative to x.

Confidence: high. Evidence: copies from the assembly (2 per number); 7 groups of mostly 4 chromosome numbers (genome partition z = 36.7); homeolog distance 0.054 vs unrelated 0.108

Auto-like or allo-like?

Allo-like (disomic-like): the duplicated sets do not interchange, from homeolog pairs (pair-depth CV 0.11). This is also what a long-rediploidized autopolyploid looks like.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: 28 chromosome numbers assessed: 28 split into lineages, 0 tetrasomic-like, 0 one divergent copy, 0 candidate

TE markers

Only the absolute marker fraction is available (two copies per number); it does not separate diploid, auto- and allopolyploid, so no reading is made from it.

Confidence: not assessable. Evidence: te_marker_fraction mean 0.1450

Rediploidization

Advanced: no stretch where homeologs are as close as alleles, and the karyotype has been rearranged since the duplication. Also: 9 chromosome(s) carry blocks homeologous to two or more others (chr01:chr02+chr04, chr06:chr05+chr07, chr09:chr10+chr12, chr10:chr09+chr12, chr12:chr09+chr10, chr20:chr17+chr18, chr23:chr21+chr22, chr25:chr19+chr28, chr28:chr25+chr27): fusions, fissions or translocations since the duplication; homeolog blocks diverged to different depths (CV 0.15), as when regions resolve at different times; 2 low-divergence homeolog blocks (16 Mb, 3% of the block span, mostly at chromosome ends; chr25xchr28): regions that stopped recombining later than the rest (delayed, LORe-like rediploidization), or a younger duplication.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: residual tetrasomy on 0/28 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers; pair-depth CV 0.11; homeology map: 46% of the genome in 76 homeolog blocks, 15 chromosome pairs, block-divergence CV 0.15; LORe-like blocks: 2, 16.2 Mb

Copy number and copy divergence (whole-chromosome matrix)

Hierarchically reordered, chromosome-number resolution

Same distance data as the heatmaps above, but collapsed to one value per chromosome NUMBER (haplotype copies aggregated away) and reordered by average-linkage clustering -- shows cross-chromosome (subgenome/ancestral-pair) structure cleanly, including diffuse structure with no individually FDR-significant pair. Red outlines mark individually FDR-accepted pairs from the homeolog test below. See INTERPRETATION.md's "checkerboard" section.
